fixture.shape: one directory; unique sizes 1 through 12000 bytes; current singleton partial-read baseline
fixture.order: control warmup, treatment warmup, control/treatment repeated three times

notes: This is the sole predeclared SOP2 Release profile and was not rerun or tuned after the failed wall result.

Both revisions keep accepted SOP1 status telemetry enabled; the cross-revision comparison includes the SOP2 producer, reducers, coalescer, and JSON transport that cancel out of the older status-database toggle profile.

The unchanged short fixture does not exercise the new 8 MiB mid-read publication path, so it is comparable to retained SOP1 evidence but insensitive to SOP2's highest possible large-file observer cadence.
Negative CPU overhead is treated as measurement noise and no detected positive CPU cost, not as an acceleration claim.
Treatment emitted fewer bounded progress frames but approximately ten times as many serialized progress bytes because the typed snapshot replaced the compact legacy frame.
The +4.39% wall result breaches the published +1% ceiling and requires an explicit operator disposition before SOP2 can be accepted.
